title: Taxable Delivery Charge Share by Ship-To State (Return Tax Credits)
content:
Some states tax the delivery charge as well as the goods. For a Returns & Exchanges return, only the part of the order's sales tax that sits on merchandise is shared out among returned lines; the part that sits on a taxed delivery charge is not.

## Tax sitting on merchandise

The part of the order's tax figure shared out among returned lines is that tax times the taxable goods that shipped, divided by those goods plus the shipping fee times the delivery charge's taxable share. When the taxable goods that shipped are zero, the whole tax figure is used.

- **Taxable goods that shipped:** for an order shipped to Pennsylvania, New Jersey or Minnesota, the accessories that shipped (accessories booked less accessories cancelled before dispatch); for any other order, all merchandise that shipped (net merchandise at placement less lines cancelled before dispatch).

## Delivery charge's taxable share by ship-to state

| Ship-to state and order | Delivery charge's taxable share |
|---|---|
| Pennsylvania, New Jersey or Minnesota, a shipping fee was charged, and accessories shipped | The accessories that shipped divided by all merchandise that shipped (these states tax a charged delivery fee in proportion to the taxable goods) |
| New York or Texas, and a shipping fee was charged | 1 — the whole fee (these states tax a charged delivery fee in full) |
| Any other order, including any order charged no shipping fee and a Pennsylvania, New Jersey or Minnesota order with no accessories shipped | 0 — none |

With a share of 0, the whole tax figure sits on merchandise.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- **New York.** Merchandise that shipped 100.00, shipping fee 10.00, tax figure 8.80. Share 1, so the tax on merchandise is 8.80 times 100.00 divided by 110.00, that is 8.00.
- **Pennsylvania.** All merchandise that shipped 140.00, of which accessories 40.00; shipping fee 7.00; tax figure 2.60. Share is 40.00 divided by 140.00, that is 0.2857…; the fee's taxable part is 7.00 times that share, 2.00; the tax on merchandise is 2.60 times 40.00 divided by 42.00, that is 2.4761… (carried unrounded).
- **Ohio.** Any shipping fee: share 0; the whole tax figure sits on merchandise.
- **Texas with free shipping.** No shipping fee charged: share 0.
